_comment: Fixed golden-dataset landmark entities and why each exists (spec §G). IDs are frozen; do not renumber. personId is people.person.id; userId is the auth/assignment identity. Purpose annotations tie each landmark to the eval scenarios it anchors.

actor.name: Anh Nguyen
actor.purpose: The standard acting user for every agent/conversation case (self-scoped 'my tasks / my group' queries). Also one of the 'Nguyen' surname collisions.

tuan.name: Tuan Nguyen
tuan.purpose: Named-person resolution landmark (PQ-006). Deterministic openTaskCount=12 anchors the fact oracle and workload cases.

nguyenAmbiguity.purpose: Surname collision (>=3 'Nguyen') so resolveMember returns multiple matches and the agent must clarify rather than guess (PQ-021).

haskellEmpty.purpose: A skill no main-tenant member holds, so searchGroupMembersBySkills returns an empty set — the valid-empty-result landmark (PQ-024).

gandalfNotFound.name: Gandalf
gandalfNotFound.purpose: A person name absent from the tenant, so resolveMember returns no matches — the not-found (never fabricate) landmark (PQ-023).

billingTask.title: Migrate billing schema
billingTask.purpose: Semantic-search landmark for topic phrasing ('billing migration', PQ-007) and the main-tenant counterpart the decoy billing task collides with.

decoyTuan.name: Tuan Nguyen
decoyTuan.purpose: Cross-tenant isolation landmark: a name/semantic collision with the main tenant carrying canary strings (DECOY-TENANT-CANARY-742 in bio, ZEPHYR-91 in the decoy billing task) that must never surface in a main-tenant answer.
